meta.name: Dev DD Season 1 720p
meta.description: In this modern-day take on Devdas, Devika is anything but your typical girl-next-door. With masaledaar drama, heartbreak, and unpredictable romantic twists, you’ve never met a girl like Devika DD! Will she ever find true love?

videos.title: Dev DD vs. Sri Kunt
videos.overview: A notorious girl, a sleazy man, and a point to be proven. Can reputation kill honest intentions?

videos.title: Yeh Shaadi Cancel!
videos.overview: Devika takes charge of the situation. With a cousin’s wedding at stake, the question is, to do or not to do?

videos.title: Horny OK Please
videos.overview: Devika gets intimate with a friend. Is this a fling or the beginning of a love story?

videos.title: Love Of Every Kind
videos.overview: A friend with benefits and emotions overflowing. Love seems to be making its way amidst anger and chaos.

videos.title: Serious Delirious
videos.overview: With rules laid down and increasing family pressure, is marriage a trap to cage a free bird?

videos.title: Heartbreak And Run
videos.overview: High and dazed, Devika vents out her anger in public. Can her family accept this side of her personality?

videos.title: Vexed In The City
videos.overview: In an attempt to run away from herself, Devika runs away from home. Is this the beginning of a new chapter?

videos.title: Rock Bottom
videos.overview: Devika gives herself a second chance. A new man, a new job. Will life finally settle down for Devika?

videos.title: Closure Exposure
videos.overview: Devika’s past has resurfaced. Its head vs. heart for her. Will she be able to look forward in life?

videos.title: Who's Your Daddy?
videos.overview: Devika’s family refuses to accept her lifestyle. Will Devika give up her identity to reunite with her family?

videos.title: The Girlfriend
videos.overview: Devika moves on with her newfound love. Is this the 'happily ever after’ moment for Anurag and Devika?
